{{Short description|Estonian physicist}}
'''Aavo Sirk''' (born in 1945<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web|title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Aavo Sirk|url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/1262/aavo-sirk|website=www.president.ee|access-date=22 March 2021}}</ref>) is an [[Estonia]]n physicist.

He has worked at [[National Institute of Chemical Physics and Biophysics]].<ref>Kiin, S.; Ruutsoo, R.; Tarand, A. 1990. ''40 kirja lugu''. Tallinn: Olion, page. 219.</ref> 

He gave his signature to [[Letter of 40 intellectuals]].<ref>Kiin, S.; Ruutsoo, R.; Tarand, A. 1990. ''40 kirja lugu''. Tallinn: Olion, page. 219.</ref> 

In 2006, he was awarded with [[Order of the National Coat of Arms]], IV class.<ref name="president.ee"/>
